policy.manual_keep: Current learner sense is valid and the corpus mismatch is attributable to a synonym, another homograph, another part of speech, transliteration noise, or a noisy corpus association. These rows are not learner errors.
policy.homograph_review: The current sense is valid or plausible, but a different common undiacritized reading may also deserve learner-facing coverage; do not auto-expand without explicit adjudication.
policy.pos_review: Meaning may be usable, but the learner-facing part-of-speech taxonomy needs separate verification.
